# btrack v0.7.0

:tada: Major release to provide updated compatibility with napari 0.6!

## What's Changed
* Bump actions/download-artifact from 3 to 4.1.7 in /.github/workflows by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/quantumjot/btrack/pull/410
* Update .readthedocs.yaml by @quantumjot in https://github.com/quantumjot/btrack/pull/415
* Unpin pydantic by @kephale in https://github.com/quantumjot/btrack/pull/414
* Update runners by @quantumjot in https://github.com/quantumjot/btrack/pull/417
* Cleanup by @quantumjot in https://github.com/quantumjot/btrack/pull/416
* Update deploy workflow by @quantumjot in https://github.com/quantumjot/btrack/pull/419
* Update deploy workflow by @quantumjot in https://github.com/quantumjot/btrack/pull/420
* workflow updates by @quantumjot in https://github.com/quantumjot/btrack/pull/423
* update to verbose deployment by @quantumjot in https://github.com/quantumjot/btrack/pull/424
* add back pypi deployment by @quantumjot in https://github.com/quantumjot/btrack/pull/425

## New Contributors
* @dependabot[bot] made their first contribution in https://github.com/quantumjot/btrack/pull/410
* @kephale made their first contribution in https://github.com/quantumjot/btrack/pull/414

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/quantumjot/btrack/compare/v0.6.5...v0.7.0
